mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that may lead the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month and the S&P 500 still produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS drops by more than 1% MoM and the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals a strengthening supply side, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 2% over 3 months and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3%, the combination signals a potential overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3%, yet the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 in a month and the S&P 500 still produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases by more than 10% MoM and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases by more than 1% QoQ and the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of the instances.
